+ #!/usr/bin/env python3
+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ URL Cleanup Script for Verzeichnis.json
+ 
+ This script fixes URLs in the Verzeichnis.json file by applying replacement rules
+ defined in the &#39;replace&#39; file and ignoring URLs specified in the ignore lists.
+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ 
+ import json
+ import os
+ import re
+ from typing import Dict, List, Set, Tuple, Any
+ 
+ class URLCleaner:
+     def __init__(self, base_dir: str = &quot;.&quot;):
+         self.base_dir = base_dir
+         self.replacement_rules = []
+         self.ignore_patterns = set()
+         self.dead_urls = set()
+         self.target_replacement = &quot;&quot;
+         
+         # Statistics
+         self.stats = {
+             &#39;total_urls&#39;: 0,
+             &#39;fixed_urls&#39;: 0,
+             &#39;ignored_urls&#39;: 0,
+             &#39;unchanged_urls&#39;: 0,
+             &#39;error_urls&#39;: 0
+         }
+         
+     def load_replacement_rules(self, replace_file: str = &quot;replace&quot;):
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;Load replacement rules from the replace file.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         replace_path = os.path.join(self.base_dir, replace_file)
+         
+         try:
+             with open(replace_path, &#39;r&#39;, encoding=&#39;utf-8&#39;) as f:
+                 content = f.read()
+             
+             # Parse the replace file
+             lines = content.strip().split(&#39;\n&#39;)
+             current_section = None
+             
+             for line in lines:
+                 line = line.strip()
+                 if not line:
+                     continue
+                     
+                 if line.lower() == &#39;replace:&#39;:
+                     current_section = &#39;replace&#39;
+                 elif line.lower() == &#39;with:&#39;:
+                     current_section = &#39;with&#39;
+                 elif line.lower() == &#39;ignore:&#39;:
+                     current_section = &#39;ignore&#39;
+                 elif line.startswith(&#39;+contents of:&#39;):
+                     # Load additional ignore file
+                     ignore_file = line.split(&#39;:&#39;, 1)[1].strip()
+                     self.load_ignore_file(ignore_file)
+                 elif current_section == &#39;replace&#39;:
+                     # Add patterns to replace
+                     self.replacement_rules.append(line)
+                 elif current_section == &#39;with&#39;:
+                     # Set the target replacement
+                     self.target_replacement = line
+                 elif current_section == &#39;ignore&#39;:
+                     # Add patterns to ignore
+                     self.ignore_patterns.add(line)
+             
+             print(f&quot;Loaded {len(self.replacement_rules)} replacement rules&quot;)
+             print(f&quot;Target replacement: {self.target_replacement}&quot;)
+             print(f&quot;Loaded {len(self.ignore_patterns)} ignore patterns&quot;)
+             
+         except FileNotFoundError:
+             print(f&quot;Warning: Replace file &#39;{replace_path}&#39; not found&quot;)
+         except Exception as e:
+             print(f&quot;Error loading replacement rules: {e}&quot;)
+     
+     def load_ignore_file(self, file_path: str):
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;Load URLs to ignore from a separate file.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         try:
+             with open(file_path, &#39;r&#39;, encoding=&#39;utf-8&#39;) as f:
+                 for line in f:
+                     line = line.strip()
+                     if line:
+                         self.dead_urls.add(line)
+             print(f&quot;Loaded {len(self.dead_urls)} dead URLs from {file_path}&quot;)
+         except FileNotFoundError:
+             print(f&quot;Warning: Ignore file &#39;{file_path}&#39; not found&quot;)
+         except Exception as e:
+             print(f&quot;Error loading ignore file: {e}&quot;)
+     
+     def should_ignore_url(self, url: str) -&gt; bool:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;Check if a URL should be ignored based on patterns and dead URL list.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         if not url:
+             return True
+             
+         # Check against ignore patterns
+         for pattern in self.ignore_patterns:
+             if pattern in url:
+                 return True
+                 
+         # Check against dead URLs
+         if url in self.dead_urls:
+             return True
+             
+         # Check for HTTP/HTTPS URLs (should be ignored)
+         if url.startswith((&#39;http://&#39;, &#39;https://&#39;)):
+             return True
+             
+         return False
+     
+     def fix_url(self, url: str) -&gt; Tuple[str, bool]:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         Fix a single URL based on replacement rules.
+         Returns (fixed_url, was_changed)
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         if not url or self.should_ignore_url(url):
+             return url, False
+             
+         original_url = url
+         
+         # Apply replacement rules
+         for old_pattern in self.replacement_rules:
+             if old_pattern in url:
+                 # Replace the old pattern with the new target
+                 url = url.replace(old_pattern, self.target_replacement)
+                 
+         # Normalize path separators (convert forward slashes to backslashes for Windows paths)
+         if url.startswith(&#39;\\\\&#39;):
+             url = url.replace(&#39;/&#39;, &#39;\\&#39;)
+             
+         return url, url != original_url
+     
+     def process_url_object(self, obj: Any) -&gt; bool:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         Process a URL object (dict with &#39;url&#39; field) and fix its URL.
+         Returns True if the URL was changed.
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         if not isinstance(obj, dict) or &#39;url&#39; not in obj:
+             return False
+             
+         original_url = obj[&#39;url&#39;]
+         if not original_url:
+             return False
+             
+         self.stats[&#39;total_urls&#39;] += 1
+         
+         if self.should_ignore_url(original_url):
+             self.stats[&#39;ignored_urls&#39;] += 1
+             return False
+             
+         fixed_url, was_changed = self.fix_url(original_url)
+         
+         if was_changed:
+             obj[&#39;url&#39;] = fixed_url
+             self.stats[&#39;fixed_urls&#39;] += 1
+             print(f&quot;Fixed: {original_url[:80]}... -&gt; {fixed_url[:80]}...&quot;)
+             return True
+         else:
+             self.stats[&#39;unchanged_urls&#39;] += 1
+             return False
+     
+     def process_data_entry(self, entry: Dict) -&gt; int:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         Process a single data entry and fix all URLs within it.
+         Returns the number of URLs that were changed.
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         changes = 0
+         
+         # Get hyperlink columns from metadata or use defaults
+         hyperlink_columns = [
+             &quot;Antrag&quot;, &quot;Datenblatt&quot;, &quot;Produkt-zulassung&quot;, &quot;SDB MSDS&quot;,
+             &quot;Gefährdungsprüfungeurteilung&quot;, &quot;Gefährdungsprüfung&quot;, 
+             &quot;Sonstiges&quot;, &quot;Schriftverkehr&quot;, &quot;Änd. Historie&quot;
+         ]
+         
+         for column in hyperlink_columns:
+             if column in entry and entry[column]:
+                 if self.process_url_object(entry[column]):
+                     changes += 1
+                     
+         return changes
+     
+     def cleanup_json_file(self, input_file: str, output_file: str = None):
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         Clean up URLs in the JSON file.
+         If output_file is None, overwrites the input file.
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         if output_file is None:
+             output_file = input_file
+             
+         try:
+             # Load JSON data
+             print(f&quot;Loading {input_file}...&quot;)
+             with open(input_file, &#39;r&#39;, encoding=&#39;utf-8&#39;) as f:
+                 data = json.load(f)
+             
+             print(f&quot;Processing {len(data.get(&#39;data&#39;, []))} entries...&quot;)
+             
+             total_changes = 0
+             
+             # Process each data entry
+             for i, entry in enumerate(data.get(&#39;data&#39;, [])):
+                 changes = self.process_data_entry(entry)
+                 total_changes += changes
+                 
+                 if (i + 1) % 100 == 0:
+                     print(f&quot;Processed {i + 1} entries...&quot;)
+             
+             # Update metadata
+             if &#39;metadata&#39; in data:
+                 data[&#39;metadata&#39;][&#39;url_cleanup&#39;] = {

+             
+             # Save the cleaned data

+             # Print statistics

+             print(f&quot;Total URLs processed: {self.stats[&#39;total_urls&#39;]}&quot;)

+         except FileNotFoundError:

+ #!/usr/bin/env python3
+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ URL Test Analyzer for Verzeichnis.json
+ 
+ This script analyzes the URLs in Verzeichnis.json to determine:

+ import json
+ import os

+ from collections import defaultdict
+ from typing import Dict, List, Set, Tuple, Any

+ class URLAnalyzer:
+     def __init__(self, base_dir: str = &quot;.&quot;):
+         self.base_dir = base_dir
+         self.ignore_patterns = set()
+         self.dead_urls = set()
+         self.replacement_rules = []
+         self.target_replacement = &quot;&quot;
+         
+     def load_rules_and_ignores(self, replace_file: str = &quot;replace&quot;):
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;Load replacement rules and ignore patterns.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         replace_path = os.path.join(self.base_dir, replace_file)
+         
+         try:
+             with open(replace_path, &#39;r&#39;, encoding=&#39;utf-8&#39;) as f:
+                 content = f.read()
+             
+             lines = content.strip().split(&#39;\n&#39;)
+             current_section = None
+             
+             for line in lines:
+                 line = line.strip()
+                 if not line:
+                     continue
+                     
+                 if line.lower() == &#39;replace:&#39;:
+                     current_section = &#39;replace&#39;
+                 elif line.lower() == &#39;with:&#39;:
+                     current_section = &#39;with&#39;
+                 elif line.lower() == &#39;ignore:&#39;:
+                     current_section = &#39;ignore&#39;
+                 elif line.startswith(&#39;+contents of:&#39;):
+                     ignore_file = line.split(&#39;:&#39;, 1)[1].strip()
+                     self.load_ignore_file(ignore_file)
+                 elif current_section == &#39;replace&#39;:
+                     self.replacement_rules.append(line)
+                 elif current_section == &#39;with&#39;:
+                     self.target_replacement = line
+                 elif current_section == &#39;ignore&#39;:
+                     self.ignore_patterns.add(line)
+                     
+         except FileNotFoundError:
+             print(f&quot;Warning: Replace file &#39;{replace_path}&#39; not found&quot;)
+         except Exception as e:
+             print(f&quot;Error loading rules: {e}&quot;)
+     
+     def load_ignore_file(self, file_path: str):
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;Load URLs to ignore from a separate file.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         try:
+             with open(file_path, &#39;r&#39;, encoding=&#39;utf-8&#39;) as f:
+                 for line in f:
+                     line = line.strip()
+                     if line:
+                         self.dead_urls.add(line)
+         except FileNotFoundError:
+             print(f&quot;Warning: Ignore file &#39;{file_path}&#39; not found&quot;)
+         except Exception as e:
+             print(f&quot;Error loading ignore file: {e}&quot;)
+     
+     def categorize_url(self, url: str) -&gt; str:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;Categorize a URL into different types.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         if not url:
+             return &quot;empty&quot;
+             
+         # Check if URL should be ignored
+         if self.should_ignore_url(url):
+             return &quot;ignored&quot;
+             
+         # Check if URL uses old patterns that should be replaced
+         for old_pattern in self.replacement_rules:
+             if old_pattern in url:
+                 return &quot;needs_fixing&quot;
+                 
+         # Check if URL already uses the new pattern
+         if self.target_replacement and self.target_replacement.rstrip(&#39;\\&#39;) in url:
+             return &quot;already_fixed&quot;
+             
+         # Check URL types
+         if url.startswith((&#39;http://&#39;, &#39;https://&#39;)):
+             return &quot;web_url&quot;
+         elif url.startswith(&#39;\\\\&#39;):
+             return &quot;network_path&quot;
+         elif url.startswith((&#39;../&#39;, &#39;..\\&#39;)):
+             return &quot;relative_path&quot;
+         elif &#39;:&#39; in url and url[1:3] == &#39;:\\&#39;:
+             return &quot;absolute_path&quot;
+         else:
+             return &quot;other&quot;
+     
+     def should_ignore_url(self, url: str) -&gt; bool:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;Check if a URL should be ignored.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         if not url:
+             return True
+             
+         # Check against ignore patterns
+         for pattern in self.ignore_patterns:
+             if pattern in url:
+                 return True
+                 
+         # Check against dead URLs
+         if url in self.dead_urls:
+             return True
+             
+         return False
+     
+     def extract_urls_from_entry(self, entry: Dict) -&gt; List[Tuple[str, str]]:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;Extract all URLs from a data entry. Returns list of (column, url) tuples.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         urls = []

+             &quot;Sonstiges&quot;, &quot;Schriftverkehr&quot;, &quot;Änd. Historie&quot;
+         ]
+         
+         for column in hyperlink_columns:

+                     url = entry[column][&#39;url&#39;]
+                     if url:
+                         urls.append((column, url))
+                         
+         return urls

+     def analyze_json_file(self, file_path: str) -&gt; Dict:
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;Analyze URLs in a JSON file and return statistics.&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         try:

+             return {}
+         
+         stats = {
+             &#39;total_entries&#39;: len(data.get(&#39;data&#39;, [])),
+             &#39;total_urls&#39;: 0,

+

+         for entry in data.get(&#39;data&#39;, []):

+             
+             for column, url in urls:
+                 category = self.categorize_url(url)
+                 stats[&#39;url_categories&#39;][category] += 1

+                 # Store examples (limit to 3 per category)

+         return stats

+         
+         if fixable_urls &gt; 0:

+         
+         return results

+ # URL Cleanup Tools for Verzeichnis.json
+ 
+ This directory contains tools to fix and analyze URLs in the Verzeichnis.json file.
+ 
+ ## Scripts
+ 
+ ### 1. url_cleanup.py
+ Main script that fixes URLs in Verzeichnis.json based on replacement rules.
+ 
+ **Features:**
+ - Reads replacement rules from the &#96;replace&#96; file
+ - Applies URL transformations to fix broken paths
+ - Ignores URLs specified in ignore lists
+ - Creates automatic backup before processing
+ - Provides detailed statistics on changes made
+ 
+ **Usage:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ cd normstelle/excelmigration/Verzeichnis/testing/urls_cleanup/
+ python url_cleanup.py
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **What it does:**
+ - Replaces old server paths with new ones:
+   - &#96;\\Dehesdna-a009a\projekte\k-z\ofs\Dokumentenservice\TeileundStoffe&#96; → &#96;\\deberdna-c010a\GlobalDE\DocumentManagement\Ofs\obl\Dokumentenservice\TeileundStoffe\&#96;
+   - Similar replacements for other old server paths
+   - Relative paths (&#96;../&#96;, &#96;..\&#96;) → new base path
+ - Ignores HTTP URLs and dead file paths
+ - Creates &#96;Verzeichnis_backup.json&#96; before making changes
+ 
+ ### 2. url_test_analyzer.py
+ Analysis script that provides detailed statistics on URL fix success rates.
+ 
+ **Features:**
+ - Analyzes URLs before and after cleanup
+ - Categorizes URLs by type (needs fixing, already fixed, ignored, etc.)
+ - Calculates success rates including and excluding ignored URLs
+ - Provides detailed breakdowns by column and URL type
+ - Compares before/after statistics if backup exists
+ 
+ **Usage:**
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ python url_test_analyzer.py
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **Reports:**
+ - Total URLs processed
+ - Fix rates (including and excluding ignored URLs)
+ - URL categories breakdown
+ - Column-wise statistics
+ - Before/after comparison
+ - Sample URLs for each category
+ 
+ ## Files
+ 
+ - &#96;replace&#96; - Contains replacement rules and ignore patterns
+ - &#96;urls_dead.txt&#96; - List of dead URLs to ignore during processing
+ - &#96;Verzeichnis.json&#96; - Main data file (large, don&#39;t open directly)
+ - &#96;Verzeichnis_backup.json&#96; - Backup created before cleanup
+ 
+ ## Replacement Rules
+ 
+ From the &#96;replace&#96; file:
+ 
+ **Replace these patterns:**
+ - &#96;\\Dehesdna-a009a\projekte\k-z\ofs\Dokumentenservice\TeileundStoffe&#96;
+ - &#96;\\Dehesdna-a007a\projekte\k-z\ofs\Dokumentenservice\TeileundStoffe&#96;
+ - &#96;\\Dehesdna-a0079a\projekte\k-z\ofs\Dokumentenservice\TeileundStoffe&#96;
+ - &#96;\\Deberdna-a018a\projekte\k-z\ofs\Dokumentenservice\TeileundStoffe&#96;
+ - &#96;../&#96;
+ - &#96;..\&#96;
+ 
+ **With:**
+ - &#96;\\deberdna-c010a\GlobalDE\DocumentManagement\Ofs\obl\Dokumentenservice\TeileundStoffe\&#96;
+ 
+ **Ignore:**
+ - HTTP/HTTPS URLs
+ - Dead file paths listed in &#96;urls_dead.txt&#96;
+ - Specific problematic URLs listed in &#96;replace&#96; file
+ 
+ ## Workflow
+ 
+ 1. **First run the analyzer** to see current state:
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    python url_test_analyzer.py
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 2. **Run the cleanup** to fix URLs:
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    python url_cleanup.py
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 3. **Run analyzer again** to see results and success rates:
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    python url_test_analyzer.py
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Expected Results
+ 
+ The cleanup process should:
+ - Fix broken network paths by updating server names
+ - Convert relative paths to absolute paths
+ - Leave ignored URLs unchanged
+ - Provide success rates typically above 80% for fixable URLs
+ 
+ ## Safety Features
+ 
+ - **Automatic backup**: Creates &#96;Verzeichnis_backup.json&#96; before any changes
+ - **Ignore lists**: Won&#39;t modify URLs that should be left alone
+ - **Detailed logging**: Shows exactly what was changed
+ - **Statistics**: Provides comprehensive reports on success rates
